verdict.rationale: GitLab's own marketing says first-party agents carry out work on the platform, turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities and reviewing code. That implies issue-driven, natural-language-directed operation, but no evidence documents a chat or natural-language command interface for operating the product. MCP connectivity is only a building block for external agents and is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a natural-language command or chat interface, the scope of operations it can perform, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Teams orchestrate, agents execute, turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities, and reviewing code, all inside the guardrails you set.
GitLab Duo can analyze the failure and provide fixes to resolve it.
